english.title: Fail to comply with a direction under s.57 not to load goods into a ship / aircraft
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse failed to comply with a requirement of a direction under section 57(4) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 that the goods in respect of which an entry was to be made should not be loaded into the

(A)_[ship]_
(B)_[aircraft]_

in which they were to be exported without the authority of the proper officer
english.legislation: Contrary to section 57(4) and (6) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
